verdict.rationale: The Literature agent is documented to run deep literature reviews that synthesize evidence across hundreds of papers, and the client can submit many tasks and wait for them to complete. However, nothing documents a systematic screening step (inclusion/exclusion criteria) or structured per-paper data extraction applied with consistent criteria; the batch task API is only a building block for that. missing for 10: documented screening against defined criteria, structured per-paper extraction output, consistency/reproducibility guarantees across papers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria

citations.quote: task it with a deep literature review synthesizing conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers
Literature handles search and synthesis tasks with high accuracy, drawing from over 175 million papers, trials, and patents.
Sometimes you may want to submit many jobs, while querying results at a later time. The platform API supports this
